sources.name: Cognipeer/synthetic-text-to-sql-tr

license.evidence: Hugging Face dataset card metadata; card states it is a Turkish translation of gretelai/synthetic_text_to_sql (Apache-2.0 per the card)

sources.justification: Table definitions (CREATE TABLE) give typed schemas; English source prompt and Turkish translation give a bilingual request pair. Only prompts whose SQL maps without loss onto Compare or Inspect, and data-modification prompts (REJECT), are adapted; the SQL is used to derive gold plans and is never taught or emitted. Translation is machine-made and not human-reviewed.
sources.suitability: partial: synthetic domains, English column names, machine-translated Turkish

sources.name: AliBugra/TURSpider
sources.publisher: Ali Bugra Kanburoglu, Faik Boray Tek (Hugging Face / GitHub)

license.evidence: Hugging Face card; the card describes the data as a human translation of Spider and does not address Spider's own dataset terms; the Spider GitHub repository ships an Apache-2.0 LICENSE file, but the dataset-level terms on the Spider project site could not be consulted from this environment

sources.justification: Human-translated Turkish questions are valuable, but redistribution terms of the upstream Spider data are not verified and Spider contains databases and questions we cannot re-license. Downloaded for review only; no derived text is committed. Re-evaluate after the upstream terms are checked by the owner.
sources.suitability: good Turkish phrasing, but SQL-centred and licence-unverified

sources.name: AlicanKiraz0/Turkish-Finance-SFT-Dataset

license.id: MIT (card metadata); README badge says Apache-2.0
license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata and README badge disagree; both are permissive

sources.justification: User questions only (no answers, no system text) are reused as Turkish out_of_scope REJECT negatives: general finance questions that are not requests to analyse a loaded table. The card claims about 10M rows while the file holds fewer (measured count in INVENTORY.json), so card statistics are not trusted.

sources.name: veripazari/Turkish-Finance-SFT-Dataset

license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata

sources.justification: Mirror of SRC-N03: the data file is byte-identical (SHA-256 equality is recorded in ACQUISITION.json); not used.

sources.name: emre/finance-reasoning-turkish
sources.publisher: Davut Emre Tasar, Enes Bulut (Hugging Face)

license.evidence: The card body states 'Academic Use Only License ... commercial use is strictly prohibited', which contradicts the AFL-3.0 metadata

sources.domain: finance Q&A with RAG context and reasoning traces
sources.justification: Conflicting licence statements (permissive metadata, academic-only body text). The content is long-form RAG reasoning, not routing. README retained as evidence only.

sources.justification: Regulation question answering has no tabular analysis content and its upstream document terms are unverified. README retained as evidence only.

sources.name: Dbmaxwell/turkish-finance-instruction-dataset (nearest match to the requested finagent-tr)

license.evidence: The card states the data mix synthetic data, manually curated data and real social-media question-answer pairs taken from online finance discussions

sources.justification: Includes scraped social-media Q&A of unknown terms and possible personal data; the requested 'Dbmaxwell/finagent-tr' does not resolve on Hugging Face. Not downloaded beyond the README.

license.evidence: Hugging Face API returned no dataset for this identifier on the access date

sources.justification: The identifier does not resolve (HTTP 401 for a non-existent or private repository). Hugging Face searches for 'finagent' returned only unrelated English datasets.

license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata

sources.justification: Non-commercial licence is incompatible with the project's MIT licence and commercial reuse; topic-named files suggest discussion text that may contain personal data.

sources.name: yusufbaykaloglu/turkish-finance-dataset

license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata; the README holds 42 bytes and documents neither provenance nor the translation source

sources.justification: Undocumented translation of an unnamed source; its upstream licence cannot be established.

sources.name: cardiffnlp/databench

license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata; the underlying tables come from third-party sources with their own terms
license.redistribution: benchmark MIT; table licences not individually verified

sources.justification: Answer-extraction questions over table values (lookups, counts), not routing to a closed set of four operations; the tables are heterogeneous third-party data. Its test split must not be training material. README retained as evidence only (the repository totals about 380 MB).

sources.name: HKUSTDial/StatQA

license.evidence: GitHub repository LICENSE file; the dataset-specific licence is not stated separately

sources.justification: Its task is choosing and applying hypothesis tests, which AXIOM rejects by contract (hypothesis_test). Copyleft code licence with unspecified data terms. LICENSE and README retained as evidence only.

sources.name: NExT-plusplus TAT-QA (GitHub) / next-tat/TAT-QA (Hugging Face)

license.evidence: Hugging Face card metadata and the GitHub README ('Creative Commons (CC BY) Attribution 4.0 International')

sources.domain: hybrid tabular and text QA over financial reports
sources.justification: Numeric reasoning over report excerpts, not requests to analyse a loaded dataset. Train split acquired for the content audit only; dev/test splits are not acquired and are never training material.
sources.suitability: reserved for a later numeric-reasoning study

sources.name: World Bank World Development Indicators (Turkiye and 14 comparison economies)

license.evidence: World Bank Data Catalog 'Data Access and Licensing' page states datasets are licensed under CC BY 4.0 unless labelled otherwise; the WDI-specific label was not separately checked

sources.domain: inflation, unemployment, GDP, trade, exchange rate, public debt, demography
sources.justification: Real country-year indicator tables. Observations stay in data/axbench-tr/economic/ and are never part of the supervised examples; only the table schema (country, year, indicator columns) feeds the corpus.
sources.suitability: good for schema realism and demos; English names only

sources.name: İzmir Metropolitan Municipality Open Data Portal (CKAN)

license.evidence: Portal licence page: all materials are licensed under CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise; datasets whose CKAN license_id is 'notspecified' are excluded

sources.domain: municipal services, prices, social aid, labour (Turkish headers)
sources.justification: Largest open source of real Turkish table schemas with typed columns. Column schemas of every table under an accepted licence feed the corpus; a small set of economic CSV tables is downloaded as real observations and kept apart from training examples.
sources.suitability: good Turkish schemas; mostly municipal, partly economic

license.evidence: TÜİK page 'Veri/Bilgilerin Ücretlendirilmesi': information offered on the website and social media is free of charge; no reuse or redistribution licence was found

sources.justification: The new portal is a single-page application behind an OIDC login flow (no anonymous API was found; no login or key is used); the legacy host data.tuik.gov.tr timed out from this environment.
